title: UX designer - Nivå 4
description:
**Om oss**  

På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov.


Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad.


Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder.  

  

**Arbetsbeskrivning**  

En större offentlig verksamhet ska ersätta ett befintligt inköpt ärendehanteringssystem med egenutvecklade systemlösningar. I rollen som **UX Designer** får du möjlighet att vara med från start och bidra till välfungerande och användarvänliga gränssnitt för verksamheten.


Systembytet kommer att genomföras stegvis under de kommande 1–2 åren. Många av de ärendetyper som hanteras är kopplade till service mot medborgare, där digitala e-tjänster utgör en viktig del av användargränssnittet. Det befintliga systemstödet används dagligen av cirka 1 000 medarbetare och är tillgängligt för hela organisationen.


Uppdraget beräknas pågå under de kommande 1–2 åren. Du kommer att arbeta i ett team bestående av uppdragsledare, utvecklare och tekniska specialister som arbetar agilt och nära verksamheten.


Uppdraget innebär att bidra till planering och implementering av nya IT-lösningar utifrån verksamhetens behov, baserade på **mikrotjänstorienterad arkitektur, OpenShift och Java-baserade applikationer**.


Det är ett långsiktigt utvecklingsinitiativ som påverkar både externa användare och organisationens interna medarbetare.

### **Kvalificeringskrav – Skallkrav**

* Konsulten ska ha minst **9 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete som UX Designer**. Uppdragen ska ha genomförts på IT-avdelningar, varav minst två uppdrag ska ha pågått i minst 2 år. Erfarenheten ska ha införskaffats under de senaste 12 åren.
* Konsulten ska ha minst **9 års praktisk erfarenhet av UX- och designarbete i en designroll**.
* Konsulten ska ha minst **5 års praktisk erfarenhet av arbete med större systemimplementationer**.
* Konsulten ska ha minst **3 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av designverktyget Sketch**.
* Konsulten ska ha en **relevant utbildning inom UX, design eller motsvarande område**.
* Konsulten ska ha god kunskap om **agila arbetssätt** samt erfarenhet av **Jira och Confluence**.
* Konsulten ska ha mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig i **svenska, både i tal och skrift**.

### **Meriterande kompetens – Börkrav**

* Erfarenhet av arbete med **egenutvecklade ärendehanteringssystem inom offentlig verksamhet** under de senaste tre åren.

title: Product Owner
description:
ECARX is a global automotive technology provider partnering with OEMs to accelerate the future of software-defined vehicles. As OEMs develop new vehicle platforms from the ground up, ECARX is developing a full-stack solutions to enhance the user experience, while reducing complexity and cost.
  
To date ECARX products have been integrated into more than 8.7 million cars worldwide, and we continue to shape the interaction between people and vehicles by rapidly advancing the technology at the heart of smart mobility. Founded in 2017, and listed on the Nasdaq in 2022, we have more than 1,800 team members across Europe, Asia and the Americas working towards one ambition: to redefine the driving experience
  
We are now looking for a Product Owner to join our team in Gothenburg.
  
About the role
  
The purpose of the role is to serve as a Product Owner. This involves defining goals and creating a vision for the assigned area from a high-level perspective. The Product Owner is responsible for generating a backlog of items and prioritizing them in accordance with the overall strategy and business objectives established by the Product Manager.
  
To ensure that the product's vision, strategy, and priorities are aligned, the Product Owner should invest a significant amount of time in understanding the product and the value it delivers. Additionally, the Product Owner serves as the primary communicator and liaison between stakeholders and teams.
  
Main responsibilities
  
Prioritizing and managing the product backlog to ensure smooth development
  
Translating strategies devised by product managers into actionable tasks for development
  
Gaining insights into the market and customer requirements to enhance product quality
  
Acting as a liaison between product and development teams to ensure seamless communication
  
Being available to answer development team's queries and concerns
  
Providing an explanation of why the product is best and how it aligns with the overall product strategy
  
Attending Feature & Planning HUB and Trinity meetings as an active member
  
Managing stakeholder expectations effectively
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
Proven experience working as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or similar role within software development.
  
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum, and experience working in Agile development teams.
  
Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs, including writing and refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  
Ability to translate business objectives and product strategies into clear and actionable development requirements.
  
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and expectations.
  
Experience gathering, analyzing, and prioritizing customer, user, and market requirements.
  
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to act as an effective bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  
Demonstrated ability to define product goals, communicate product vision, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
  
Experience working closely with software developers, UX/UI designers, and other product team members throughout the development lifecycle.
  
Ability to make prioritization decisions and provide clear guidance to development teams in a fast-paced environment.
  
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders simultaneously.
  
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English.

title: Idé till digital lösning
description:
**Utmaning & mål**  

När en ny strålskyddslag trädde i kraft innebar det att betydligt fler verksamheter – som tandläkare, veterinärer och arbetsplatser med radon – omfattades av anmälningsplikt. Strålsäkerhetsmyndighetens dåvarande, manuella process med posthantering var inte längre hållbar. Myndigheten behövde en digital lösning som kunde lanseras i tid för att uppfylla det nya lagkravet – med krav på säkerhet, skalbarhet och användarvänlighet.


**Lösning**  

Agero satte samman ett erfaret team med arkitekt, utvecklare och UX-designer som kunde arbeta effektivt från dag ett. Lösningen som togs fram omfattade både ett gränssnitt för verksamheter som skulle göra anmälningar och ett verktyg för myndighetens handläggare att hantera dem. Systemet integrerades med bland annat BankID för säker inloggning och möjliggjorde fakturering direkt i samband med anmälan.



Arbetet bedrevs agilt i tvåveckorssprintar med löpande demos och prioriteringar tillsammans med kunden, vilket gjorde att teamet kunde hålla ett högt tempo utan att tumma på kvaliteten.


**Resultat**  

Efter fem månader var systemet i drift – lagkravet var uppfyllt, och myndigheten hade ett hållbart och förvaltningsbart system på plats. Användarupplevelsen förbättrades markant, både för de verksamheter som gör anmälningar och för de handläggare som behandlar dem.



***”Att projektet skulle gå i mål och bli så här bra var inget vi vågade hoppas på. Det enda tråkiga är att vi inte får fortsätta jobba med teamet från Agero.”***



– Melina Assadpur, Projektledare, Strålsäkerhetsmyndigheten

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
   

  

**We Are Proud Of**

* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration


**The role**
 Do you want to design digital experiences that truly make a difference – for users, clients, and society?
   

  

 Valtech Sweden is looking for a
 **Senior** 
**UX/UI Designer** 
 who thrives at the intersection of design, technology, and business – and who brings practical experience working with AI in digital products. At Valtech, we combine design, technology, and business to create experiences that truly matter. You will be part of a strong, collaborative community and work on projects where quality, innovation, and user value are at the core.
   

  

 As a
 **UX/UI Designer**

 You will work across both UX and UI, moving seamlessly from insight and structure to high-quality, implementation-ready design.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve design systems to ensure consistency and scalability
* Design user experiences where AI is a meaningful and integrated component
* Ensure clarity, usability, and trust in AI-related interactions and flows
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners and client stakeholders
* Work with developers in agile teams to ensure designs are implementation-ready
* Facilitate and contribute to workshops with clients and internal teams


**We believe you have** 
  

  

* 7+ years of experience working across both UX and UI
* Hands-on experience working with AI in digital products, for example:
+ Designing AI-supported features or user flows
+ Working in projects where AI is part of the end-user experience
+ Using AI tools in a structured and repeatable way in your design process

* Strong experience working with design systems in scalable environments
* Excellent ability to translate concepts into concrete, high-quality interfaces
* Experience working closely with developers and understanding technical constraints
* Strong ability to structure and clarify requirements end-to-end
* A pragmatic, confident, and collaborative mindset
* Solid experience with Figma or similar tools
* Experience working with accessibility standards (WCAG)


**Language**
* You are fluent in Swedish


**Nice To Have Qualifications**
* Experience conducting user testing in fast-paced environments
* Data-driven design experience
* Experience with complex flows (e.g. e-commerce, booking)


**We Offer**
* Exciting assignments with leading brands
* A high degree of freedom with responsibility
* Opportunities to influence both your own development and our solutions
* A flexible hybrid work environment
* A centrally located Stockholm office
* Daily breakfast and fika


**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
   

  

**The Benefits**
 This is a
 **full-time** 
 job position based in
 **Stockholm,** 
 with a
 **hybrid working model** 
 (at least 2-3 days work from our Stockholm office).
   

  

**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer**
* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts


 Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

 Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

title: Product Designer
description:
**About Air Apps**
 At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco - we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
   

  

 Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
   

  

 Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
   

  

****The Role****
 As a
 **Product Designer** 
 , you will be responsible for crafting intuitive, delightful user experiences that seamlessly span mobile (iOS and Android) and web platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Product Management, Engineering, and User Research—to translate complex requirements into elegant, user-centered designs. You will leverage your design sensibilities, storytelling abilities, and understanding of technology constraints to build consistent, scalable solutions that resonate with a wide range of users.
   

  

* This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.


**Responsibilities**
* Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to deeply understand user needs, pain points, and behaviors. Translate insights into wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.
* Develop and maintain design systems and component libraries that ensure a cohesive look and feel across iOS, Android, and web interfaces while respecting platform-specific patterns and guidelines.
* Own the entire design process - from concept ideation and user flows to final visual design - ensuring a pixel-perfect, responsive experience across devices and screen sizes.
* Work closely with Product Managers to shape product strategy and define requirements, and partner with Engineers to ensure technical feasibility and a smooth handoff of assets and specifications.
* Continuously refine designs based on user feedback, A/B testing results, and analytics. Strive for iterative improvements that drive measurable increases in user satisfaction, engagement, and retention.
* Advocate for user experience best practices and contribute to the ongoing improvement of design processes, tooling, and team culture.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to less experienced designers, fostering a collaborative and inclusive design environment.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or related field.
* Approximately 3+ years of experience in modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD).
* Solid understanding of layout, typography, and color theory, with an eye for detail and usability.
* Familiarity with native mobile design patterns (Human Interface Guidelines for iOS, Material Design for Android) as well as responsive web design principles.
* Experience conducting user research, usability testing, and applying both qualitative and quantitative feedback to improve designs.


**What benefits are we offering?**
* Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
* Annual Bonus
* Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
* Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
* Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
* Childcare support.
* Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
* Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
* Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.
* Meals 100% free at the hub.


****Diversity & Inclusion****
 At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
   

  

****Application Disclaimer****
 At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

title: Design System Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Design at Worldline is going through an exciting transformation. We're raising the bar — fast. At the centre of that transformation is our Design System: a world-class foundation we're building with talented people who care deeply about craft, consistency, and scale. It's already creating significant impact across our product portfolio, and we're just getting started. The ambition is high, the team is strong and growing more diverse every day, and there's a real sense that we're shaking things up.
   

  

 As our Design System Manager, you will own the strategy, governance, and evolution of the Worldline Design System — the shared foundation that enables our product teams to deliver consistent, high-quality experiences at scale. Coming from a design background, you understand the craft and the "why" behind every component; with a strong affinity for frontend development, you can bridge the gap between design decisions and technical implementation. Your mission is to make the Design System a product in its own right — one that serves designers and developers alike, accelerates delivery, and raises the quality bar across our entire product portfolio. You will lead cross-functional collaboration, align stakeholders, and build the processes that keep the system healthy and evolving.
   

  

 This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

**Day-to-day Responsibilities**
* Own the vision, roadmap, and governance of the Worldline Design System, treating it as a product with clear goals, priorities, and success metrics.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of design system components — from identifying needs and defining patterns, through design and documentation, to handoff and adoption tracking.
* Bridge the gap between design and frontend engineering, ensuring components are both designerly and technically sound — working closely with developers who implement the system in code.
* Establish and maintain contribution guidelines, quality standards, and governance processes so the system scales sustainably.
* Collaborate closely with product designers across teams to understand their needs, gather feedback, and ensure the system evolves to support real product challenges.
* Champion design tokens, accessibility standards, and responsive patterns to ensure consistency across platforms and products.
* Nurture adoption of the Design System across product teams, providing training, documentation, and hands-on support to designers and developers.
* Stay ahead of design system trends, tooling innovations, and frontend technologies to continuously improve how we build and maintain our system.
* Actively explore opportunities for our business and the field of design systems with generative and Agentic AI — from automated documentation to intelligent component suggestions.
* Advocate for the Design System as a strategic asset within the organisation, communicating its value to senior stakeholders and product leadership.
* Become a key member of the Worldline Design team, shaping our design infrastructure and contributing to our culture of consistency, craft, and mutual support.


**Who Are We Looking For**
 We look for talented, thoughtful people who care about their craft and the people they serve. People who bring fresh perspectives, step up and show what's next — optimistic, upbeat people with a can-do attitude, a hunger to learn and grow, and a genuine love for collaboration. In practice this means:
   

  

* 5+ years of experience in product design or design systems, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience building, maintaining, or managing a design system.
* A design background with a strong understanding of UI design principles, component architecture, design patterns, and visual consistency.
* Frontend affinity — you may not write production code daily, but you understand HTML/CSS, component frameworks (e.g., React), design tokens, and how design translates to implementation. Hands-on frontend experience is a strong plus.
* Proven experience managing a design system as a product — including roadmapping, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and adoption measurement.
* Expert-level Figma skills, including component architecture, variants, variables, auto-layout, and library management.
* Strong understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG) and how they apply to design system components.
* Experience creating and maintaining design system documentation that serves both designers and developers.

**Shape the evolution**
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

 Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

title: Consumer Analyst
description:
Are you passionate about building true consumer preference—turning data and insights into real user and business impact?
   

  

 At Instabee, we are on a mission to become the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. We are now looking for a Consumer Analyst to join our Consumer Department. In this role, you will play a fundamental part in building the analytical foundation and insights required to ensure our organization is aligned, informed, and accountable for delivering a superior consumer experience across all markets.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Consumer Analyst, you will translate complex data and consumer signals into clear, actionable insights that can drive strategic and tactical impact. Partnering with teams across Data & Analytics, Product, Design, Operations, Strategy and Market to understand challenges, synthesize insights from diverse sources, and co-create solutions grounded in consumer and business relevance.
   

  

 Your goal is to build a solid foundation for consumer, brand, and experience analytics, making insights accessible and actionable company-wide. Whether you are mapping the behavior of different consumer segments, uncovering what drives long-term retention, or tracking the impact of a new product feature, you will play a key role in guiding our journey toward becoming the undisputed #1 service in all our markets.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Manage the Consumer Scorecard: Define and evolve our core KPIs (NPS, User ratings, Brand preference, CSAT, MAU, Consumer base metrics, Operational metrics etc.) to ensure a trusted, single source of truth for our performance across the full consumer journey and lifecycle.
* Analyze Loyalty & Retention: Conduct cohort and retention analysis to identify the key drivers of consumer satisfaction and long-term loyalty. You’ll explore how different user segments behave and evolve, and translate user and service delivery insights into cross-functional guidance for the most effective ways to win, delight, and retain our consumers.
* Analyze Consumer Behavior: Dive deep into user behavior across web, app, communications and customer service channels. You will analyze funnels and identify drop-off points to provide concrete product and experience recommendations. This includes proactively identifying tracking gaps and defining what needs to be measured and how, to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable data.
* Translate Data into Action: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, actionable insights. You will provide a holistic lens to ensure we deliver a seamless and superior experience across the entire consumer journey.
* Co-create Analytical Foundations: Partner with data and tech teams to ensure our data collection is high-quality, scalable, and reliable. You’ll help shape the tracking and data structures (e.g., GA4, BigQuery) required to turn digital behavior into trustworthy insights.
* Drive Performance Insights: Enable data-driven decision-making through forecasting, trend analysis, and the development of automated dashboards in Tableau, Steep or similar tools.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the consumer analytics partner for teams across Instabee, helping them move past the "what" to understand the "why" behind consumer behavior.
* Drive Experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests—taking ownership from the initial hypothesis to the final conclusion and recommended next steps.


**Your profile**
 You are an analytical problem-solver with a natural drive to uncover patterns and understand exactly what drives consumer behavior and business performance. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by creating real-world results rather than theoretical perfection. You don't just provide data; you see it as your mission to provide the actionable insights that enable our teams to deliver a great consumer experience and our business to grow.
   

  

**Experience & Mindset**
* Analytical Experience: 4-5+ years of experience in consumer analytics, digital analytics or a related field - ideally within a fast-paced service or e-commerce environment.
* Commercial Curiosity: You have a strong business acumen and a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers. You focus on what is relevant and actionable for the business, and proactively surface insights and opportunities.
* Problem Solver: Strong analytical and numerical skills with a business-oriented mindset. You excel at bringing structure to ambiguous problems and can navigate complex datasets to find the most impactful answers.
* Communication: You can translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable narratives for diverse stakeholders. You communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership.
* Collaboration: Team player who enjoys working across Product, Tech, and Business teams to develop insights and build solutions together.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, IT, Statistics, Business, or other relevant field.


**Analytical toolkit**
* Consumer Analytics: Proven ability to synthesize various internal and external consumer data into holistic consumer analytics and insights.
* Digital Analytics: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, GA4, or similar behavioral tracking platforms.
* Data Foundations: Proficiency in SQL and Python or similar, and experience working with large datasets.
* Visualization: Ability to build and maintain clear dashboards and funnels that give our teams an ongoing view of consumer health (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Steep).
* AI coding tools: Experience in using AI tools in your analytical work is an advantage.
* Experimentation: Hands-on experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests is an advantage.
* Tracking: Knowledge of digital tracking implementation and Google Tag Manager is an advantage.


**What You'll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description**

 H&M is continuing to shape the future of digital commerce by creating stable, connected, and customer-focused experiences across our global digital landscape. Within Digital Transaction, we are strengthening our end-to-end technical coordination across key customer journeys such as login, cart, checkout, payment, order management, and returns.
   

  





 We are now looking for a Service Delivery Manager to help safeguard end-to-end technical coherence, integration integrity, and operational readiness across the Digital Transaction area. This role supports the Area Tech Manager by ensuring that independently accountable product teams collectively deliver a stable, resilient, and customer-safe end-to-end solution.
   

  





 This is not a governance layer. It is a coordinating and enabling role focused on transparency, early risk visibility, and technical alignment across teams, products, platforms, and external vendor integrations.
   

  





**WHAT YOU’LL DO**



* Maintain a holistic end-to-end technical view across the Digital Transaction customer journey.
* Continuously update and communicate the E2E integration landscape across products and components.
* Identify cross-component risks, integration breakpoints, and architectural drift before they impact customers.
* Safeguard critical customer journeys, including login, cart, checkout, payment, order management, and returns.
* Ensure integration sequencing, dependency transparency, and API contract discipline across teams and vendors.
* Support coordinated E2E go-live readiness for multi-component releases.
* Validate E2E test readiness, deployment coordination, and operational preparedness across product areas.
* Ensure observability, traceability, resilience, and error handling consistency across the full customer journey.
* Surface technical debt and structural misalignment that may impact customer-facing stability.
* Support incident analysis by helping teams treat issues as end-to-end journey concerns rather than isolated product failures.
* Provide the Area Tech Manager with clear E2E risk visibility, early escalation points, and proactive recommendations.



**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**




 You will work closely with the Area Tech Manager, Solution Architects, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Operations, Program Managers, and multiple product teams across the Digital Transaction area.
   

  





 You will play an important role in connecting technical perspectives across teams and making sure that dependencies, risks, and customer impact are visible early. You will support alignment across independently accountable teams without taking over their mandate or decision authority.
   

  





 We are looking for someone who enjoys collaboration, complexity, and problem-solving across teams. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment where technical coordination, clear communication, and proactive risk management are key to delivering stable customer experiences.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**



* You have solid experience working in complex digital, ecommerce, platform, or transaction-heavy technology environments.
* You understand end-to-end customer journeys and how technical dependencies across systems can impact customer experience.
* You have experience coordinating technical delivery, integration readiness, or operational readiness across multiple teams.
* You have strong knowledge of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, and cloud-based architectures.
* You understand observability, monitoring, tracing, error handling, resilience, and production stability.
* You are experienced in identifying cross-team dependencies, integration risks, and technical gaps.
* You can translate complex technical risks into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders.
* You are comfortable working with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, Product Managers, Operations, and Program Managers.
* You have strong communication and stakeholder management skills.



**WHO WE ARE**




 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**




 At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer attractive benefits, flexible ways of working, and extensive opportunities for professional growth across our global organization.
   

  





 You'll work on business-critical enterprise platforms, collaborate with talented global engineering teams, and help shape the future of supply chain technology using modern cloud, integration, and AI-driven engineering practices.
   

  





**JOIN US**




 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

title: Verksamhetsanalytiker
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens försäkrings- och pensionserbjudanden i ett av Sveriges största försäkringsbolag? På Folksam arbetar vi för att skapa verkligt värde för våra kunder genom smarta lösningar, datadrivna beslut och nära samarbete mellan verksamhet och IT.
 



  





 Nu söker vi verksamhetsanalytiker som vill bidra till vår fortsatta utvecklingsresa och vara med och skapa lösningar som är hållbara för både kunder och Folksam.
 



  





**Det här gör du som verksamhetsanalytiker på Folksam** 




 Som verksamhetsanalytiker översätter du verksamhetens krav till en realisering som är i linje med beslutade strategier, planer och målsättningar, från koncern- till teamnivå.
 



  





 Du tar fram och paketerar krav och samverkar med behovsägare, Product Owner och leveransteamen i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT för att skapa en gemensam förståelse och säkerställa att utvecklingen stödjer både verksamhetens och kundernas behov. I arbetet tydliggör och konkretiserar du utvecklings- och förändringsbehov, och du använder datadrivna analyser för att identifiera mönster, behov och effekter som stärker beslutsunderlagen till dina krav.
 



  





 Genom att integrera ett tydligt användar- och kundperspektiv i dina analyser och lösningsförslag säkerställer du att utvecklingen ger verkligt värde för dem som berörs.
 



  





 Vidare planerar och leder du projekt, uppdrag och workshops inom analysarbetet och skapar strukturer som hjälper organisationen att fatta välgrundade beslut.
 



  





 Du genomför fördjupade analyser av påverkan på verksamhet, processer, användarupplevelse och teknik, och du arbetar lösningsorienterat för att identifiera både kortsiktiga och långsiktiga förbättringar.
 



  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 För att trivas och vara framgångsrik som verksamhetsanalytiker hos oss ser vi att du kommunicerar tydligt och tryggt med olika målgrupper – både inom verksamheten och i teknikorienterade sammanhang. Du har lätt för att förklara komplexa frågor på ett begripligt sätt och kan föra fram budskap som skapar förståelse, samsyn och framdrift.
 



  





 Du är nyfiken, initiativrik och bidrar gärna med nya idéer, perspektiv och angreppssätt. Dina förslag bygger på analys och verkliga behov, och du har förmågan att omsätta idéer till krav och praktiskt genomförbara lösningar. Du arbetar datadrivet när det behövs, samtidigt som du har känsla för verksamhetsnytta och kundupplevelse.
 



  





 Vi söker dig som planerar, organiserar och prioriterar ditt arbete på ett strukturerat och effektivt sätt, exempelvis genom process- och kravdokumentation. Din strategiska förmåga märks genom att du ser helheten, förstår samband och kan bedöma både långsiktiga konsekvenser och operativa effekter. Du skapar tydlighet i komplexa frågor och trivs i roller där din analytiska, kommunikativa och strukturerade sida får utrymme.
 



  





 Beroende på din bakgrund kan du komma att arbeta inom våra områden för sakförsäkring eller liv- och pensionsförsäkring.
 



  





 Du har erfarenhet av:
 


* verksamhetsanalys, behovsanalys och kravarbete i en komplex och föränderlig verksamhet.
* att identifiera, analysera och konkretisera verksamhetsbehov till tydliga krav.
* behovsbeskrivning, kravanalys, kravspecificering och att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till lösningar som kan realiseras av utvecklingsteam.
* att följa ett behov från analys och kravarbete till implementering och effekthemtagning.
* projekt- eller uppdragsledning.
* att leda förändringsledning och säkerställa effekthemtagning.
* att arbeta kund- eller användarcentrerat och säkerställa att utveckling skapar önskat värde.
* att planera, leda och facilitera workshops och dialoger med olika intressenter.
* pensions- eller försäkringsbranschen (meriterande).



  





 Du har utbildning från universitet/högskola med önskad inriktning IT, systemvetenskap eller ekonomi alternativ har du jämförbar arbetserfarenhet.
 



  





 Rollen kräver att du kan kommunicera och arbeta professionellt på både svenska och engelska.
 



  





**Här kan du göra skillnad** 




 Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär.
 



  





 Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 



  





 Läs mer och se filmer om livet hos oss på folksam.se/jobb-och-karriar.
 



  





**Så söker du jobbet** 




 Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan redan idag, men senast 20 september 2026
 



  





 Vill du veta mer om jobbet är du välkommen att kontakta sektionschef Fredrik Ershammar (affärsområde Liv) på 073-439 34 18 eller avdelningschef Lovisa Ivarsson (affärsområde Sak) på 072-582 65 34.
 



  





 Här kan du läsa mer om vilka bakgrundskontroller som kan vara aktuella i den här rekryteringen.
 



  





 Fackliga representanter: Akademikerföreningen Susanna Järnek 070-831 69 46 eller Ann-Louise Andersson 070-831 61 44, Forena Anneli Ersson 070-831 69 22 eller Lotten Johansson 070-831 68 21 och Handels Mikael A Carlsson 070-831 51 32.
 



  





*Kundägda Folksamgruppen erbjuder sedan 1908 försäkringar och sparande som ger trygghet i livets alla skeden. Vi gör det enklare för våra fyra miljoner kunder att känna sig trygga i en hållbar värld genom rätt försäkringar, rätt sparande och rätt hjälp när något händer.*

title: PAM AI Lead
description:
The
 **PAM AI Lead** 
 is a newly created role within the Player Account Management department, established to drive the execution of our #AI strategy. You will capture the AI needs of the organisation and ensure that our offering of tools, training, and best practices enables PAM to excel in an increasingly AI-driven landscape.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead the integration of AI into all aspects of our workflow, setting clear goals and KPIs and acting as the primary point of contact for all things AI — from tooling and exploration to new opportunities. By building and enabling a network of technical experts and AI ambassadors across PAM, you will provide hands-on support, organise training, trial new tools, and ensure best practices are widely shared.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* Be accountable for the execution of the #AI strategy in PAM, driving outcomes, adoption and continuous improvement
* Own the AI tool offering for PAM, ensuring the needs of the organisation are understood, documented and met with the right solutions
* Set goals and KPIs for AI usage and outcomes within PAM, tracking data on costs, adoption rates and productivity improvements
* Act as the primary point of contact for all AI-related questions and suggestions — both within PAM and across other Tech departments — driving common agendas and joint evaluations
* Build and enable a community of internal AI ambassadors and technical experts, fostering an AI-first culture that inspires, trains and supports all team members
* Run trials and assess new tools, maintaining market awareness and distinguishing between hype and realisable value
* Own a PAM catalogue of approved and recommended MCPs and Skills, keeping it current and relevant
* Safeguard AI tool usage in collaboration with Group Security, maintaining a healthy balance between productivity and security
* Organise Geek Sessions and other training initiatives to build AI capability across the department
* Collaborate cross-functionally with other Tech departments to share lessons learned and run joint efforts



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* Strong understanding of AI — its opportunities, risks and practical applications in a business context
* Data-driven mindset — comfortable setting metrics, tracking adoption and using evidence to drive decisions
* Market awareness — you keep a keen eye on AI developments and can separate meaningful trends from noise
* Stakeholder management — able to engage, influence and collaborate across teams at all levels
* Change leadership — comfortable driving cultural and operational change in a complex organisation
* Security-conscious — understands the trade-offs between productivity and risk, and navigates them confidently
* Highly organised — capable of managing multiple workstreams, priorities and stakeholders simultaneously
* Curious and proactive — always looking for the next opportunity to empower colleagues and improve outcomes

title: Solution Consultant - Public360
description:
***Vill du vara med och forma framtidens digitala offentlig sektor?***
*Hos Tieto får du en nyckelroll där du hjälper verksamheter i offentlig sektor att omsätta komplexa verksamhetsutmaningar till digitala lösningar. Här kombinerar du verksamhetsförståelse, rådgivning och modern teknik för att skapa verklig nytta för samhällsviktiga verksamheter.* 




  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Tieto stärker sin roll som strategisk partner till offentlig sektor och hjälper organisationer att omsätta digitalisering till verksamhetsnytta. Som Solution Consultant blir du en nyckelperson i den utvecklingen.
 



  





 Du arbetar i gränssnittet mellan verksamhet och IT och hjälper kunder att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till digitala lösningar med hjälp av Public 360˚. Det handlar om att förstå kundens verksamhet, utmana nuläge och skapa lösningar som ger långsiktig verksamhetsnytta. Du är med tidigt i kunddialogen där du hjälper kunden att strukturera behov, skapa samsyn och lägga grunden för rätt lösning. Därefter följer du kunden genom hela resan – från de första dialogerna till införande, vidareutveckling och långsiktigt värdeskapande.
 



  





 Rollen sträcker sig långt bortom produktexpertis. Du bygger långsiktiga kundrelationer, driver affärsutveckling och agerar strategisk rådgivare som hjälper kunder att utveckla sin verksamhet med hjälp av modern teknik.
 



  





 Du blir en del av ett engagerat team med hög kompetens och stor frihet att påverka. Här värdesätter vi samarbete, kunskapsdelning och eget ansvar – och ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor i en miljö där vi lär av varandra och driver utvecklingen framåt.
 



  





**Du erbjuds** 



* En utvecklande roll på ett ledande IT-bolag med starkt fokus på samhällsnytta.
* En roll där du får stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka kundernas digitala resa i en miljö med hög kompetens och god sammanhållning.
* En spännande möjlighet att arbeta i gränssnittet mellan strategi för offentlig sektor, verksamhetsutveckling och modern teknik.
* Hybridarbete och flexibla arbetstider som ger en god balans mellan arbete och fritid.



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 




 Rollen innebär att proaktivt stödja kunder i deras digitala transformation genom att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till värdeskapande lösningar med hjälp av Public 360˚. Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter innebär att:
 


* Agera strategisk rådgivare: bygga långsiktiga relationer, förstå kundens verksamhet och hjälpa beslutsfattare att prioritera initiativ som skapar verksamhetsnytta.
* Leda affärsdialoger, workshops och behovsanalyser: hjälpa kunden att strukturera verksamhetsutmaningar, kartlägga och visualisera processer, skapa samsyn och definiera en tydlig målbild innan lösningen utformas.
* Omsätta behov till lösningskoncept: översätta verksamhetsbehov, krav och regelverk till rekommendationer och lösningar baserade på Public 360˚.
* Kommunicera affärsnytta: presentera lösningar och tydliggöra värde, effekter, investeringar och organisatoriska konsekvenser.
* Driva långsiktig kundutveckling: stödja och utveckla kundernas användning av Public 360˚ för att skapa långsiktigt värde.
* Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt: arbeta nära säljorganisation, projektledning, leveransteam och produktorganisation för att säkerställa framgångsrika kundprojekt.
* Bidra till teamets utveckling – utveckla arbetssätt, metoder och konsultkompetens tillsammans med kollegor.



  





**Vi söker dig som** 




 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av en konsultativ roll där du arbetat nära kunder med komplexa IT-lösningar, verksamhetsutveckling eller digital transformation. Du känner dig trygg i dialogen med kunder, är van att skapa förtroende hos olika intressenter och trivs med att vägleda beslut även när behoven inte är helt tydliga. Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av:
 


* Erfarenhet av en konsultativ roll där du arbetat nära kunder med komplexa IT-lösningar, verksamhetsutveckling eller digital transformation.
* Förmåga att leda affärsdialoger, workshops och behovsanalyser där du hjälper kunden att strukturera verksamhetsutmaningar, kartlägga och visualisera processer, skapa samsyn och definiera en tydlig målbild innan lösningen utformas.
* Erfarenhet av att driva affärsutveckling genom att identifiera nya möjligheter och skapa långsiktigt värde för kunden.
* Erfarenhet från offentlig sektor eller andra informationsintensiva verksamheter.
* Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.



  





**Det är meriterande om du har** 



* Ärende- och dokumenthantering eller Enterprise Content Management (ECM).
* Informationshantering eller digitalisering inom offentlig sektor.
* Informationssäkerhet och GDPR.



  





**För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:** 



* Hjälpsam
* Målmedveten
* Ansvarstagande
* Socialt självsäker
* Intellektuellt nyfiken



  





 Som person söker vi dig som är nyfiken, analytisk och har ett starkt eget driv. Vi ser att du är självgående, strukturerad och trygg i komplexa sammanhang. Utöver detta är du förtroendeingivande och kommunikativ i dialog med kunder och beslutsfattare. Vi ser gärna att du är prestigelös, samarbetsorienterad och är affärsmässig med ett genuint intresse för kundens verksamhet.
 



  





**Därför ska du välja Tieto och Public 360˚** 




 Hos Tieto får du möjlighet att arbeta med Public 360˚ – en av Nordens ledande plattformar för ärende- och dokumenthantering som används av över
 **500 organisationer och 300 000 användare** 
 . Tillsammans har vi en tydlig ambition att bli Europas ledande plattform för Enterprise Content Management och Decision Support inom offentlig sektor.
 



  





 Du blir en del av en miljö där teknik och verksamhetsutveckling möts för att skapa verklig samhällsnytta. Vi tror på samarbete, kunskapsdelning och stort eget ansvar. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor, delta i internationella kompetensnätverk och arbeta med lösningar som gör konkret skillnad för offentlig sektor – varje dag.
 



  





**Vår rekryteringsprocess** 




 Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
Are you passionate about delivering exceptional customer experience to entrepreneurs and partners? We are hiring for a committed
 **Customer Success Associate** 
 to join our dynamic team!
   

  

**About Froda**
 Froda was founded in 2015 with a clear mission: to democratize the access to financing and provide small businesses the same opportunities to grow as large ones. Through digital processes and technological innovation, we have shortened the loan process from months to minutes, making it easy for business owners to invest in their ideas.
   

  

 At Froda, we are making fair, fast, and accessible financing the new standard. But we’re not stopping there. Through embedded lending, we’re seamlessly integrating our technology into the world’s leading banks and fintechs, creating a future where businesses get the funding they need instantly, right where they are. Backed by cutting-edge tech and bold ambition, we’re building the next generation of lending infrastructure. Join our team and contribute to giving small businesses the opportunity to invest in their ideas to the best possible terms.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will be the first point of contact for our customers, essential in providing high-quality support and contributing to their overall satisfaction. Your talent for understanding customer needs, coupled with your problem-solving skills, will not only resolve their issues but also enrich their experience with Froda.
   

  

 In addition to supporting our end customers, you will also play a key role in supporting our embedded partner collaborations ensuring they receive the same level of outstanding service and engagement as our direct customers.
   

  

**You will**
* Deliver exceptional customer service via email, and phone.
* Support and guide our partners’ support teams by answering questions, solving issues, and ensuring they have what they need to deliver a great experience to their users.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve customer issues efficiently.
* Cross collaborate with other teams such as Product to share customer feedback to improve our services.


**Who you are**
* You possess excellent communication skills in Swedish and English, as well as fluency in a third language, such as Spanish, French or German (these are just examples). If you speak another language, we’d still be happy to hear from you. As we continue to expand, we’re excited to learn how your language skills could contribute to our growth.
* Experience in customer service, support, or a similar role is preferred.
* You have an empathetic approach to handling customer queries and complaints.
* You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with both customers and external partners.
* Able to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* You are tech-savvy and comfortable navigating customer support platforms and tools.


**What’s in it for you?**
 Working at Froda is everything you can expect from working at a tech scale: fun and fast-paced. We are 90+ ambitious people who work together mostly at the office, with few scheduled meetings. The culture is friendly, with a get-shit-done attitude. At Froda, you will truly have freedom under responsibility. This means that you will have the ability to impact your own work and tackle a wider set of tasks.
   

  

 Furthermore, you’ll get:
   

  

* Fun & exciting work environment in a fast-growing and profitable scale-up
* Competitive compensation package
* Insurance and pension plan
* The possibility to work in our awesome office in Stockholm
* Friendly culture that values work/life balance
* Monthly after-works that are actually fun


 If you're passionate about delivering unparalleled customer service, both to entrepreneurs and to our partners and want to be part of our mission to redefine the banking experience, apply to join us as a Customer Success Associate today!

title: Area Business Manager People
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**




 As Area Business Manager for the People area, you will help shape how we support our colleagues and managers through clear, effective and user friendly people processes and tools. This is a forward looking role in an area where we are still shaping the future, with the opportunity to bring a modern, relevant and creative perspective to how people solutions are designed, prioritised and brought to life. You will set priorities, guide improvements and work closely with HR, tech and market teams to make sure our tech solutions meet real business needs and create a better everyday experience for our people.
   

  





 You will:
   

  




* Set a clear direction for how the People area supports colleagues, managers and HR teams across the organisation.
* Turn business and people needs into clear priorities, plans and actions that create value in everyday work.
* Lead improvements across the employee journey, making our people processes, services and tools easier to use, more reliable and more effective.
* Work closely with People, Tech and market teams to connect real business needs with practical solutions that can scale across the organisation.
* Make thoughtful choices on what to focus on first, balancing colleague experience, compliance, capacity, cost and long-term impact.
* Create alignment between different teams and stakeholders, helping them work together towards shared outcomes.
* Ensure the area is run responsibly, with clear ownership of resources, budgets, risks and continuous improvement.
* Lead, coach and develop a team, with formal people management responsibility for creating a collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking environment where people can grow and do their best work.



**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**




 You will work in close co-leadership with the Area Tech Manager, collaborating with the wider Area Tech team to connect business needs with technology direction, delivery and resource priorities. A key part of the role is also to partner with the process teams across the People Life Cycle, ensuring that our solutions are shaped by real needs across our people processes and create value for colleagues, managers and HR teams. Together you will help build simple, scalable and future ready solutions that support the full employee journey.
   

  





  

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 We know that relevant experience can take different forms. What matters is that you understand the complexity of working across people, process and technology, and that you are motivated by building something better in a fast moving environment where priorities can change. You are comfortable stepping into unclear situations, working hands on with others and helping teams move forward even when the full plan is not yet defined.
   

  





***We are looking for people with***
 …
   

  




* Experience from leading change, business development, transformation or product/service delivery within HR, People, shared services or another complex environment.
* Strong understanding of HR processes, employee data, employee lifecycle capabilities and how digital tools can make work easier, more consistent and more effective for colleagues, managers and HR teams.
* The ability to turn business and people needs into clear priorities, practical plans and outcomes that others can understand and act on.
* Financial acumen with experience managing budgets, investments, and resource allocation.
* Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to balance value creation, cost optimization, and ROI.
* Experience working in changing environments where priorities shift, plans evolve and progress depends on close collaboration across different teams.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, including the confidence and perseverance to work through different opinions, competing priorities and difficult conversations.
* Knowledge of governance, risk, compliance and operational excellence in relation to HR data, access, platforms, integrations or global people processes.
* Relevant HR understanding, with the ability to connect people related needs, processes and data to business outcomes.
* A degree within HR, business administration, organisational development, technology or a related field.



***And people who are…***



* Customer-focused and value-driven.
* Collaborative and hands on, with the ability to build strong partnerships while also getting close to the details when needed.
* Able to connect long term ambitions with day-to-day execution, even when the path forward is not fully clear.
* Resilient and persistent, with the energy to keep moving forward through complexity, changing direction and stakeholder challenges.
* Empowering leaders that develop people and create an inclusive environment.
* Curious, innovative, and open to new perspectives.
* Accountable, proactive, and focused on delivering outcomes.
* Clear communicators who can create alignment and engagement across diverse stakeholder groups, especially when priorities are unclear or opinions differ.



  

  

**WHO WE ARE**




 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**




 At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
   

  





 An example of our benefits:
   

  




* 25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
* H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.
* With a presence in markets around the world, we offer extensive career development and international mobility.



  

  

**JOIN US**




 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
   

  





*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

title: Creative Designer
description:
**About Air Apps**
 At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
   

  

 Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
   

  

 Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Creative Designer at Air Apps, you will play a crucial role in shaping our brand identity and delivering visually engaging designs across multiple platforms. You will collaborate with various teams to ensure a cohesive and compelling user experience, working on digital ads, social media content, landing pages, email campaigns, and print materials.
   

  

* This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.


**Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain a consistent visual identity that aligns with Air Apps’ brand guidelines.
* Create engaging graphics, illustrations, infographics, and layouts for web, social media, email campaigns, and print materials.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Content teams to translate requirements into compelling visual solutions.
* Iterate on designs based on feedback from stakeholders and refine assets using user insights and performance metrics.
* Ensure high-quality output and conduct design quality assurance across various channels.
* Utilize industry-standard design software (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma) to create and deliver assets in multiple formats.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* Around 3 years of experience creating assets for digital marketing campaigns, social media, and web.
* Strong portfolio showcasing a range of design projects and styles.
* Knowledge of typography, color theory, layout, and design best practices.
* Proficiency in industry-standard design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma.
* Strong communication, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, remote environment and collaborate effectively across teams.


**What benefits are we offering?**
* Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
* Annual Bonus
* Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
* Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
* Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
* Childcare support.
* Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
* Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
* Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.
* Meals 100% free at the hub.


**Diversity & Inclusion**
 At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
   

  

**Application Disclaimer**
 At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.
   

  

 Compensation Range: €44K - €55K

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Air Apps**
 At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
   

  

 Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
   

  

 Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
   

  

****The Role****
 As a
 **Data Analyst** 
 at Air Apps, you will be responsible for
 **analyzing and interpreting data** 
 to drive business insights and optimize product performance. You will create
 **reports, dashboards, and performance metrics** 
 to help teams make informed decisions and improve user experience.
   

  

 This role requires a
 **data-driven mindset, strong analytical skills, and experience with visualization tools** 
 to turn complex data into actionable insights.
   

  

* This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.


**Responsibilities**
* Analyze user behavior, product performance, and key business metrics to identify trends and opportunities.
* Create and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Google Data Studio.
* Collect, clean, and structure large datasets to ensure accuracy and usability.
* Define and track KPIs for marketing, product, and business performance.
* Work with SQL, Python, or R to extract, analyze, and manipulate data.
* Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and marketing teams to provide data-driven insights.
* Conduct A/B testing and experiment analysis to improve product features and user engagement.
* Identify bottlenecks and opportunities in user journeys and customer funnels.
* Present findings in a clear and compelling way to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Stay up to date with industry trends, analytics best practices, and emerging data tools.


**Requirements**
* Around 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field.
* Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.
* Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Google Data Studio).
* Strong analytical skills with experience in Python or R for data analysis.
* Knowledge of A/B testing methodologies and statistical analysis.
* Experience with Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar user analytics tools.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with large datasets and cloud-based data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake).

title: Data Scientist, Company Planning & Execution
description:
How does a company with thousands of people building hundreds of products stay focused on what matters most? That's the question the Company Planning and Execution (CPE) team works on every day. We design the systems, processes, and insights that help Spotify plan, prioritise, and deliver at scale.
   

  

 As a Data Scientist on CPE, you'll sit at the intersection of data, strategy, and operations. You'll bring clarity to complex questions by turning operational and strategic information into clear stories, recommendations, and decision frameworks that help leaders and teams act faster and smarter. You'll also explore how AI and automation can change the way people access insights and make decisions.
   

  

 You'll work closely with data scientists, engineers, PMs, and business partners across the company to help refine how Spotify executes at scale. If you like making sense of ambiguity, care about how organisations work, and want your analysis to shape real decisions, this is the role.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Formulate hypotheses related to how Spotify plans and delivers, and communicate insights effectively to a range of audiences.
* Apply analytical techniques — including statistical models and machine learning — to identify trends and generate insights that improve how we work.
* Build and maintain the data models, pipelines, and dashboards that provide visibility into how Spotify plans and executes.
* Develop structured narratives and recommendations — not just charts, but the "why" and "so what" — in our semi-annual Planning and Execution Insight reports and recurring briefings.
* Explore how AI and automation can make insights faster to produce and easier to access across the company.


 Who You Are
   

  

* Curious about how organisations work — not just the data, but the decisions and systems behind it.
* 5+ years of experience with a quantitative background in science, economics, engineering, or a related field.
* Strong interpersonal skills and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders across levels and functions.
* Able to take messy, complex datasets and turn them into clear recommendations and stories that land with non-technical audiences.
* Proficient in SQL and Python, comfortable in BigQuery, and experienced with tools like dbt, Tableau, or Looker.
* Experience with operational or work management data is a plus.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best, with 2–3 days per week in the office.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

**Who is your future team?**
----------------------------


You will join the imaging laboratory team in Lund, responsible for developing and maintaining the internal tools used by Axis imaging engineers. The team takes strong ownership of its service — a service that plays an essential role in delivering the best forensic image quality on the market.


You will belong to the software part of the group, working alongside colleagues on the hardware side.


**What you'll do here as Experienced Software Engineer – Imaging Tools & Test Automation**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


This role exists to support our imaging engineers by maintaining and developing the frontend and backend of the imaging lab interface. The scope extends to any tooling or automation that improves the quality and efficiency of imaging development work.


* Own and improve the Linux and Windows server environments that power our imaging labs
* Develop and enhance the web-based tools our engineers rely on every day, both frontend and backend
* Maintain, improve and automate our imaging tests, and develop new ones
* Bring new hardware devices into the lab environment
