title: Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer
description:
**The role**
 Agents are only as good as the knowledge they can reach. Most retrieval today is flat: chunk a document, embed it, hope the nearest vector is the right answer. That breaks the moment a question needs more than one hop, needs to know which source to trust, or needs to distinguish two entities that happen to share a name. Redpine is building the layer that fixes this: a knowledge graph over the licensed data we hold across medicine, science, law, and finance, served directly to agents over our API, MCP, and CLI.
   

  

 You will own that graph end to end, from raw multimodal sources to the structured, provenance-bearing knowledge that agents query in production. This is an early, high-ownership role. The decisions you make about how we model and link knowledge will shape what every agent built on Redpine can actually reason about.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Ontology and schema design. Define the entity types, relations, and constraints that licensed data from each domain maps into, building on the established ontologies those fields already use rather than reinventing them. You will decide where a shared ontology helps and where a domain needs its own.
* Entity resolution at scale. Deduplicate, canonicalize, and disambiguate entities across heterogeneous, multimodal sources, so the same thing in the world is one node in the graph.
* Confidence and conflict. Attach confidence to every link, and define what happens when two sources disagree. Decide what the graph asserts, what it flags, and what it surfaces to the agent.
* Provenance as a first-class property. Preserve attribution on every node and edge, back to the source document and the license that covers it. At Redpine this is not optional, it is the product.
* Keeping the graph live. Detect when an upstream source changes and propagate that change, so the graph reflects current knowledge instead of a stale snapshot.
* Graph-powered retrieval. Build multi-hop traversal, hybrid graph-and-vector retrieval, and the kind of structure a reranker can actually exploit.


**What we're looking for**
* Deep, direct experience with knowledge graphs: graph databases, property or RDF graphs, entity resolution, and ontology design. You have shipped one, not just read about them.
* Strong Python and a track record of building data pipelines from scratch.
* Real experience with retrieval and RAG, ideally graph-backed, plus the judgment to know when a graph earns its keep and when it is just overhead.
* Judgment about messy data. You can look at multi-source, contradictory input and design a schema that survives contact with reality.
* A bias toward small, clear systems. You question whether something needs to be built before you build it.
* A genuinely curious mind, the kind that wants to understand a domain well enough to model it honestly.


**Why this role**
 Agents don't just look things up, they traverse. They follow a claim to its source, a company to its filings, a drug to its trials to the patients those trials enrolled. That kind of multi-hop reasoning needs explicit structure: typed entities, named relations, and a graph a planner can walk.
   

  

**Practical details**
* Based at Redpine HQ in central Stockholm. Office-first, with real autonomy for deep-work days and life admin.
* Requires a valid Swedish work permit or similar eligibility. Relocation support available.
* Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
* Small team, high ownership. The same people design, ship, and run the systems.


**About Redpine**
 If models were the first wave of AI, and compute the second, we are building the data layer that comes next. Only a small fraction of the world's data is on the open internet. The rest, high-quality, domain-specific, often critical, sits behind paywalls, in databases, or with rights holders. Redpine is building the infrastructure to unlock it.
   

  

 We provide AI builders and autonomous agents with access to licensed, high-quality, multimodal data through a unified platform and API. The goal is simple: make AI systems more accurate, more useful, and grounded in real-world information.
   

  

 You will work closely with the founding team, including Anders (ex-partner at VC, McKinsey) and David (ex-tech and product leader at Spotify, Zettle, and Lunar). We are backed by Nordic Ninja, Node VC, and Luminar, alongside angels from OpenAI, Spotify, and Perplexity.
   

  

 If you are eager to make a meaningful impact in the AI space, we would love to hear from you. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: Product Manager - Customer Service Platform
description:

 You’ll help improve the advisor experience through intelligent tooling, define how customers reach support across channels, and strengthen the API layer underpinning our service ecosystem. Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the tools our support advisors use every day, improving efficiency and enabling better outcomes for users.
* Define and evolve how customers access support across chat, email, social messaging, and emerging channels, helping the right contact reach the right advisor at the right time.
* Strengthen the foundational API layer connecting our support systems, with a focus on reliability, extensibility, and developer experience as the platform scales.
* Take initiatives from discovery through launch, partnering closely with engineering to ship iteratively, learn quickly, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to thoughtfully apply AI and automation within advisor workflows and channel routing to improve speed, accuracy, and the advisor experience.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, and customer service operations to build scalable capabilities that serve both advisors and users.
* Define meaningful success metrics, run experiments, and use data and customer insights to make clear prioritisation decisions and measure impact.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have 4+ years of product management experience and a track record of delivering impactful products in technology-driven environments.
* You think in systems and understand how APIs, integrations, platforms, and tooling can work together to create leverage across an organisation.
* You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on API design, system architecture, and technical trade-offs; you don't need to write code, but you can engage confidently in technical conversations.
* You know how to take products from discovery through delivery, balancing thoughtful product development with the pace needed to learn and make progress.
* You are curious about customer service and support operations and bring empathy for both the people providing support and the users receiving it.
* You communicate clearly, can make complex trade-offs understandable, and know how to create alignment across technical and non-technical partners.
* You use data, experimentation, customer insight, and judgement to make decisions and are comfortable adapting when you learn something new.
* You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines and care about building products that create meaningful outcomes for customers and the people who support them.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: ERP-Specialist (Business Central)
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla hur ERP stöttar verksamheten?
   

  

 På Svea Solar befinner vi oss mitt i en transformationsresa där IT går från traditionell systemförvaltning till att bli en aktiv möjliggörare för verksamheten. Vi har en tydlig ambition att kraftigt öka automationsgraden genom hela kundresan. Vi utvecklar därför hur våra plattformar samverkar, med målet att allt fler processer kring exempelvis kundupplägg, projekt, inköp, fakturering och ekonomiska transaktioner ska kunna ske automatiskt.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en erfaren ERP-specialist med gedigen kompetens inom Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central till vårt Group IT-team i Stockholm.
   

  

 Låter det som nästa utmaning för dig?
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta hands-on i Business Central samtidigt som du får möjlighet att ta ansvar för förbättringar och driva initiativ framåt. Salesforce är en central del av vår kommersiella plattform, medan Business Central har en viktig roll när kundresan går vidare mot leverans och ekonomi.
   

  

 Du blir en del av Group IT och arbetar nära vår befintliga ERP-kompetens, Finance och teamen som ansvarar för Salesforce, integration och automation.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som som tillsammans med teamet vill förbättra, förenkla och automatisera hur våra ERP-processer stödjer verksamheten.
   

  

 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Förvalta och vidareutveckla vår Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central-miljö
* Driva förbättringar och automatisering av ekonomi- och ERP-relaterade processer
* Arbeta med initiativ inom exempelvis e-faktura, bankintegrationer och automatiserade ekonomiflöden
* Vara med och utveckla integrationerna mellan Salesforce, Business Central och andra system
* Översätta verksamhetens behov till skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara ERP-lösningar
* Identifiera manuella processer och hitta möjligheter att förenkla eller automatisera dem
* Bedöma när vi bör använda standardfunktionalitet, konfiguration, integration eller anpassad utveckling
* Arbeta nära Finance och andra delar av verksamheten för att förstå behov och omsätta dem till fungerande lösningar
* Testa, dokumentera och hjälpa till att ta förbättringar hela vägen till produktion


 🌍 Life as a Power Shifter - Vad erbjuder vi dig
   

  

* Möjligheten att Make an Impact – ditt arbete bidrar direkt till att fixa planeten och driva energiomställningen.
* En värderingsdriven arbetsplats - läs mer om våra värderingar här.
* Chansen att äga dina resultat - – väx, ta ansvar och power up i takt med att vi och energibranschen utvecklas.
* En inkluderande kultur - olika perspektiv driver innovation, hos oss kan du vara dig själv och bidra med dina erfarenheter, identiteter och idéer.
* Trygga villkor - Tjänstepension, 30 semesterdagar, friskvårdsbidrag, parkering m.m.
* Flexibilitet/hybridarbete - jobba upp till två dagar i veckan hemifrån.


 Vill du se hur livet hos oss faktiskt ser ut? Följ oss på Instagram: @LifeAtSveaSolar
   

  

 Är vi en match?
   

  

 Vi tror att du har flera års erfarenhet av att arbeta hands-on med Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central eller Dynamics NAV. Du förstår både systemet och affärsprocesserna bakom det och känner dig trygg i gränslandet mellan IT och ekonomi.
   

  

 Du behöver inte vara utvecklare för att lyckas i rollen. Det viktiga är att du har en djup förståelse för Business Central och kan bidra till hur processer, data och integrationer bör struktureras för att skapa långsiktigt hållbara lösningar
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:
   

  

* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central eller Dynamics NAV
* Ekonomi- och redovisningsprocesser
* Integrationer och API kopplade till ERP
* Miljöer med flera bolag eller juridiska enheter
* Processautomation
* E-faktura, betalningsflöden och bankintegrationer
* Kravställning och lösningsdesign
* Test och implementation


 Meriterande:
   

  

 Erfarenhet av Salesforce, integrationsplattformar eller automationsverktyg, exempelvis Power Automate, är meriterande men inget krav.
   

  

 Listan kan kännas lång, men ingen är bäst i alla kategorier. Sök om du känner igen dig någorlunda.😊
   

  

 ⚡Vilka vi är
   

  

 Svea Solar är en av Sveriges - och en av Europas - ledande aktörer inom energiteknik samt leverantör av solenergi och smarta energilösningar. Vi hjälper våra kunder att optimera sin energianvändning med solpaneler, värmepumpar, batterier, laddboxar, elavtal och vår egen mjukvara. Vi kallar det
 **The Power Shift.** 
 Och vi som driver det framåt?
 **Power Shifters.**
**Om vår rekryteringsprocess**
* Alla kandidater bedöms på lika villkor, med strukturerade frågor och tester via Alva Labs för att säkerställa en rättvis och inkluderande process.
* Läs mer om vår rekryteringsprocess här.


 👉
 **Redo att bli en Power Shifter?** 
 Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din!

title: Doktorand i kvantinformationsteori
description:
**Projektbeskrivning**




**Forskarutbildningsämne:** 
 Elektro- och systemteknik
   

  





 Projektet finansieras av Vetenskapsrådet och Wallenberg Centre for Quantum Technology (WACQT) och behandlar grundläggande frågor inom kvantinformationsvetenskap, med tillämpningar inom kvantkommunikation, kvantberäkning och andra former av kvantinformationsbehandling. Det övergripande målet är att fastställa de yttersta gränserna för vilka resurser som krävs och vilken prestanda som kan uppnås i sådana uppgifter, samt att utveckla explicita protokoll som uppnår eller närmar sig dessa gränser. En central utmaning är att uttrycka gränserna i matematiskt hanterbara och beräkningsmässigt tillgängliga former. Idéer och metoder från kvant-Shannonteori kommer att vara särskilt användbara, tillsammans med verktyg från sammanflätningsteori och kvantinformationens bredare matematiska grunder. Projektet kommer att undersöka grundläggande informationsteoretiska storheter, däribland entropi, ömsesidig information, kanalkapaciteter och olika mått på sammanflätning, samt hur dessa beter sig när kvantsystem eller informationsbehandlingsresurser kombineras. Frågor om additivitet och icke-additivitet utgör en viktig del av detta bredare forskningsprogram.
   

  





**Handledning:** 
 Professor Mikael Skoglund
   

  





**Behörighet för antagning**




 För att bli antagen till forskarutbildning (kap 7 39 § högskoleförordningen) krävs att den sökande har grundläggande behörighet:
 


* avlagt en examen på avancerad nivå, eller
* fullgjort kursfordringar om minst 240 högskolepoäng, varav minst 60 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå, eller
* på något annat sätt inom eller utom landet förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper.



 Den sökande ska kunna uppvisa mycket goda matematiska kunskaper relevanta för informationsteori, särskilt inom linjär algebra och sannolikhetsteori.
   

  





 Utöver ovanstående finns också ett obligatoriskt krav på engelska motsvarande Engelska B/6.
   

  





**Urval**




 För att lyckas med dina doktorandstudier på KTH behöver du vara målinriktad och ihärdig i ditt arbete. Vid urval av de sökande bedöms förmågan att:
 


* självständigt driva sitt arbete framåt,
* kunna samarbeta med andra,
* ha ett professionellt förhållningssätt och
* analysera och arbeta med komplexa frågor.



 Tidigare erfarenhet av kvantinformationsteori är meriterande.
   

  





 Efter behörighetskraven kommer stor vikt läggas vid personliga egenskaper.
   

  





**Målexamen:** 
 Doktorsexamen
   

  





**Information om antagning och anställning**




 Endast den som antagits till forskarutbildning får anställas som doktorand. Den sammanlagda anställningstiden får inte vara längre än vad som motsvarar utbildning på forskarnivå på heltid under fyra år. En anställd doktorand kan i begränsad omfattning (högst 20 %) utföra vissa arbetsuppgifter inom t.ex. utbildning och administration. En ny anställning som doktorand gäller för högst ett år, anställningen får därefter förnyas med högst två år i taget. Vid studier som ska avslutas med licentiatexamen får den sammanlagda anställningstiden inte vara längre än vad som motsvarar utbildning på forskarnivå på heltid under två år.
   

  





 Som doktorand får du del av KTH:s anställningsförmåner och har en månadslön enligt KTH:s avtal för doktorandlöner. Läs mer om Forskarstudier vid KTH | KTH | Sweden.
   

  





**Fackliga representanter**




 Kontaktuppgifter till fackliga representanter.
   

  





**Doktorandsektionen (Tekniska högskolans studentkår)**




 Kontaktuppgifter tilldoktorandsektionen.
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in.
   

  





 Ansökan ska ha följande innehåll
 


* Kopior av examensbevis och betyg från tidigare universitetsstudier och intyg på uppfyllda språkkrav (se ovan). Översättningar till engelska eller svenska om originaldokumentet inte är utfärdade på ett av dessa språk. Kopior av original ska vidimeras
* CV med relevanta professionella erfarenheter och kunskaper.
* Ansökningsbrev med en kortfattad redogörelse om varför du vill bedriva forskarstudier, om dina akademiska intressen och hur de relaterar till dina tidigare studier och framtida mål. (Max 2 sidor)
* Representativa publikationer eller tekniska rapporter. För längre dokument, bifoga gärna en sammanfattning (abstract) och en webblänk till den fullständiga texten.



 Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
   

  





**Övrigt**




 För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering.
   

  





 Det kan förekomma att en anställning hos KTH är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning.
   

  





 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.
   

  





**Bli en del av KTH**




 KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet.
   

  





 Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.

title: IT-konsult - spontanansökan till Eccera
description:

 Eccera fortsätter att växa och vi söker kontinuerligt efter skickliga konsulter som vill vara en del av vårt team och bidra med expertis, engagemang och modern teknisk kompetens.
 



  





 Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär.
 



  





*Just nu är vi särskilt intresserade av dig som arbetar inom något av följande områden:* 



* **Nätverkstekniker** 
 Erfarenhet av routing, switching, brandväggar, nätverksdesign samt felsökning
* **Systemadministratör** 
 Erfarenhet av drift, underhåll och förvaltning av Windows och/eller Linuxmiljöer
* **Windowstekniker** 
 Fokus på Active Directory, serverdrift, förvaltning, klienthantering, patchning och Microsoft 365
* **Linuxspecialist**

* **IT-supporttekniker** 
 Erfarenhet av IT-support på olika nivåer: 1st, 2nd och 3rd line, samt onsitesupport



  





**Vi söker dig som har:** 



* Relevant utbildning och/eller dokumenterad erfarenhet inom ditt specialistområde
* God teknisk förståelse och förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och lösningsorienterat
* Erfarenhet av arbete i komplexa IT-miljöer, gärna inom större organisationer
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift



  





 Som person är du ansvarstagande, professionell och trivs i en konsultroll där samarbete, kommunikation och kvalitet är centrala delar.
 



  





*Passar inte någon av ovanstående roller in på din spetskompetens?* 




 Utöver ovanstående roller välkomnar vi även spontanansökningar från dig som besitter annan relevant IT-kompetens. Om din profil inte exakt matchar någon av rollerna, men du har erfarenhet och spetskunskap som kan skapa värde i våra kunduppdrag, uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in din ansökan.
 



  





**Vad vi erbjuder** 




 På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. Vi sätter stort värde på att våra medarbetare hela tiden ska fortsätta att utvecklas. Därför erbjuder vi dig möjligheten att lägga upp en individuell utbildningsplan, där vi bekostar såväl studiematerial som själva certifieringarna. Under din utveckling kommer vi matcha din kompetens mot rätt uppdrag i takt med att du avancerar.

title: Product Image Engineer Stockholm
description:
**Job Title**
-------------

Product Image Engineer Stockholm
**Job Description**
-------------------


**Product Image Engineer to our R&D site in Stockholm**

*At Axis, we’ve always been about pushing the boundaries in pursuit of innovating for a smarter, safer world. We do this by developing IP-based products and innovations for security and video surveillance. We’re looking for a Product Image Engineer to help us develop more network tech innovations at our Stockholm site!*


**Who is your future team?**  

Working together in a team, you will be a part of how our new multi-channel cameras come to life. At Axis, product image engineers are responsible for the product image quality, thus they are involved in the whole product development process.


In this role, you will collaborate with co-workers from different disciplines, such as mechanical design, electronics, software, production testing and many more.


Our most important asset is our ability to cooperate, act as a team, and be open. If you are a person that likes to get involved, make a difference, and nudge the world a little bit in the right direction, you will feel at home with us.


**What you´ll do as a Product Image Engineer**  

As an Image Engineer at Axis you will work in a cross functional team to develop new cameras from a concept phase to a complete product. Your responsibility will be to optimize the image regarding optics, image sensor and image processing. You will also setup production tests and support the production test flow by analyzing test results/statistics, on- and off-site. The role as a Product Image Engineer is very broad, and you will work closely with many different roles and organizations at Axis.


Your main tasks will be:


* Optimizing image quality in new camera development projects. This is done by tuning auto-exposure and auto-focus, noise filtering, white balance, color-calibration and other image processing algorithms. Participating and contributing to the choice of optics and image sensors. This is done in cooperation with the mechanics and electronics teams as well as external partners.
* Supporting the production test flow in camera projects by testing prototypes on production machines on- and off-site and by analyzing test data/statistics.
* Developing prototype cameras and testing them in our imaging lab as well as outdoor, both in day and night conditions and following GDPR.

**Who are you?**  

You are curious, have a great passion for technology, love challenges and enjoy solving them in a team-focused atmosphere.


You also have relevant education in engineering (master’s degree level), and have 2-3 years’ experience working with hardware, e.g. optics or electronics. You enjoy not only simulation and analysis work but also hands-on work with hardware in the lab. You are structured and organized, and like contributing to the team's way of working.


It’s a plus if you have experience with


* Optics/electronics (such as cameras, microscopes, telescopes etc.)
* Image sensors
* IR filters and IR diodes
* Image processing algorithms
* Linux development environment

**What Axis has to offer:**  

This is a unique opportunity to be part of building our new R&D office in Stockholm. On one hand, having the advantages of being a small and agile site while at the same time being part of an exciting, successful organization that is already the world leader in network video.


We want you to enjoy working with us, and we offer benefits such as flexible working hours, morning coffee every day, Friday cake, company bonus, attractive wellness benefits, health insurance and your very own Axis bicycle - to name a few.


**Curious to discover more?**  

We have a host of places where you can learn more about Axis; our products and solutions, our company culture, and what working at Axis is really like. Check out:


Life at Axis blog
  

Engineering at Axis blog
  

Innovation at Axis
  

  

**Ready to Act?**  

Join us! We go through applications continuously so don't wait - apply today!


If you have any questions, or would like to know more, reach out to recruiting manager, Hanna Al-Maawali at +46 46 272 1800


**Type of Employment**
----------------------


Permanent Employment
**Posting End Date**
--------------------


2026-09-30
*Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments.* *Notice will be provided before we take any action.*

**About Axis Communications**
-----------------------------


We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.


With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.


**Let´s create a smarter, safer world**

For more information about Axis, please visit our website www.axis.com .

title: Research Engineer in Medical Image Processing and Machine Learning
description:
**The Department of Physics** (Fysikum) is one of the largest departments within the Faculty of Science at Stockholm University, fostering a dynamic and international research environment. This position is based within the Division of Medical Radiation Physics, where we conduct advanced research in medical physics, radiation physics, computational algorithms and AI for oncological applications. For more information, please visit: Department of Physics - Stockholm University .

**Main responsibilities**
-------------------------


The Research Engineer will architect, expand, and maintain a high-performance, containerized computing platform dedicated to medical data analysis and artificial intelligence workflows. In this role, the engineer will design and deploy scalable MLOps pipelines for automated model training, experiment tracking, and clinical inference, while managing Kubernetes cluster orchestration, distributed storage systems, and multi-tenant GPU resource allocation. Key technical responsibilities include integrating healthcare data infrastructure such as DICOM servers, PACS interfaces, and web-based visualization tools as well as developing active learning pipelines and interactive annotation interfaces for human-in-the-loop validation. The engineer will also build secure RESTful APIs and backend microservices, implement identity and access management protocols compliant with healthcare data privacy standards, and maintain automated CI/CD testing and deployment pipelines to ensure platform resilience.


Operating at the intersection of computational engineering and healthcare, the engineer will interact with computer scientists, medical engineers, and clinicians. The role involves translating complex clinical and research requirements into robust software specifications, directly facilitating the deployment and prospective evaluation of cutting-edge AI models in clinical workflows. Additionally, the engineer will monitor cluster performance, optimize computational workloads, and provide hands-on technical support and onboarding for researchers and clinical users.

**Qualification requirements**
------------------------------


The candidate must hold a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Essential qualifications include strong proficiency in Linux environments and Python programming, proven hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes container orchestration, backend/API development (RESTful services and database integration), and standard software development workflows using Git.


Excellent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an interdisciplinary environment alongside engineers and clinicians are required.


Meriting qualifications include practical experience with Electronic Health Record (EHR), medical imaging standards (DICOM, NIfTI) and imaging servers (Orthanc, PACS, 3D Slicer), familiarity with medical AI frameworks and MLOps pipelines (PyTorch, MONAI, MLflow, Kubeflow), experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Ansible), and knowledge of enterprise security protocols (Keycloak, OIDC) for sensitive health data.

**About the employment**
------------------------


This is a full-time, fixed-term position for 5 months, with the possibility of extension (up to a total of 7–8 months, depending on project funding). Stockholm University practices individual salary determination. Start date: as soon as possible, by mutual agreement.

**We offer**
------------


With us, you will experience the dynamic interaction between higher education and research that makes Stockholm University an exciting and creative environment. You will work in an international environment and get favourable conditions. The university is located in the National City Park with good transport links to the city.


Stockholm University strives to be a workplace free from discrimination and with equal opportunities for all.

**Contact**
-----------


Further information about the position can be obtained from Associate Professor Mehdi Astaraki, phone: +46 8 553 786 18, mehdi.astaraki@fysik.su.se.

**Application**
---------------


Apply for the position at Stockholm University's recruitment system. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application is complete and that it is submitted before the deadline.


The instructions for applicants are available at: How to apply for a position.


Stockholm University contributes to the development of sustainable democratic society through knowledge, enlightenment and the pursuit of truth.

title: System Safety Engineer - Power Electronics
description:
**Help us shape the future of mobility**  

At Volvo Cars, we’re on an exciting journey to shape the future of mobility. We’re building direct relationships with customers, and aim to be a leader in new technology. It’s so exciting – we’re well on our way on our journey towards full electrification. Join us and become a part of our vision for the future – a future that's both exciting and a catalyst for positive change.

**Let's introduce ourselves**
-----------------------------



Our Power Electronics department is a pioneering business unit within Volvo Cars, responsible for designing & developing innovative products such as traction inverters, on-board chargers & DC/DC converters. We are constantly working to improve our power electronics products in terms of efficiency, power density, weight and cost with enhanced quality from one generation to the next.
  

  

We have highly skilled team members in each technical domain of the Power Electronics systems including both hardware and software design.  

Most importantly, we prioritize the safety of the customers when using our vehicles and we apply this fundamental requirement to all our product designs. We are now looking for a System Design Engineer to join our team!  

  

The Power Electronics department at Volvo Cars is a pioneering business unit responsible for the design and development of cutting edge products such as traction inverters, on board chargers, and DC/DC converters. These systems are at the heart of our electrified vehicles and play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable mobility.  

We continuously drive innovation to improve our power electronics products from one generation to the next — pushing the boundaries of efficiency, power density, weight, cost, and quality. Our work is carried out by highly skilled engineers across all technical domains of power electronics systems, covering both hardware and software design.  

Safety is our highest priority. Protecting our customers is a fundamental requirement that guides every aspect of our system and product design.  

To strengthen our team, we are now looking for a System Design Engineer who is passionate about electrification, safety and high quality engineering solutions.  

Join us and help shape the next generation of safe, efficient, and high performance electric vehicles.

**What you'll do**
------------------



In this role, you will be part of our inverter system team, focusing mainly on system design and requirement elicitation for the inverter. You will be in continuous dialogue with several stakeholders and architects to find the best solution overall, while balancing the different demands of the product with legal and other regulatory requirements. Your deliveries will be picked up by our development teams on both hardware and software side for further refining and development into the product we put on the market.  

  

You will be responsible for:

To be successful in this role, we believe you have knowledge of Electric Drive systems and requirements management. You are familiar with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), including SACA part 4, PRSP part 4 and TSC part 4, as well as ASPICE and have experience working with MATLAB/Simulink.

**Volvo Cars. For Life.**  

For nearly a century, Volvo Cars has empowered people to move freely in a personal, sustainable and safe way. Today, we are driving bold advancements in electrification, sustainability and automotive safety. To realise our ambitious vision, we are seeking innovative minds who are ready to tackle the challenges of tomorrow – today.

title: Postdoctoral researcher in Human-Robot Interaction
description:
Have you ever tried to "make eye contact" with a faceless robot to figure out what it's about to do? Join us for an exciting research project at the forefront of robotics innovation, to figure out a better way for robots to communicate with people!


**About us**
------------



The Department of Computer Science and Engineering, a joint department of Chalmers and the University of Gothenburg, spans the breadth of computing disciplines. Our internationally visible research, strong industry links and diverse environment create a collaborative setting where ideas grow into real impact.



At the division of Interaction Design and Software Engineering, we design smarter ways to engineer better software, and explore how people engage with digital systems, combining global research perspectives with strong collaboration with industry.



You will join a thriving research group in Human-Robot Interaction, currently comprising 5 PhD students, 2 research assistants, and several robots.


**About the research project**
------------------------------



Robots are entering human spaces, but they are still struggling to communicate effectively with us. If a robot cannot clearly signal what it is about to do, coordination breaks down, trust weakens, and, especially in safety-critical contexts, such misunderstandings can have serious consequences.



The postdoctoral researcher will join an existing team working on developing a novel, universal framework for robot communication that is both platform-independent and context-adaptive. Instead of designing communication strategies for one robot at a time, the goal is to establish principled foundations for how robots can communicate, regardless of which robot, which context, which environment. This interdisciplinary project combines theory-driven research with empirical investigation. It will involve data collection in real-world settings as well as controlled user studies, alongside the development of new theoretical models of human-robot communication. The postdoctoral researcher will work alongside experts in Linguistics and Human-Robot Interaction.



We are looking for a motivated and curious postdoctoral researcher, ideally with a background in communication (verbal and / or nonverbal) in HRI, who is eager to work at the intersection of social science and robotics, and contribute to shaping the future of how humans and robots understand each other. The postdoctoral candidate is expected to contribute to the ongoing project, but there will also be flexibility to carry out independent research work that is relevant to the research group.


**Who we are looking for**
---------------------------


#### ***The following requirements are mandatory:***


* A doctoral degree (or an equivalent foreign degree) in **Human-Robot Interaction, Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science,** **Robotics, Psychology,** or related discipline. This eligibility requirement must be met no later than the time the employment decision is made.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience in the field of Human-Robot Interaction (demonstrated e.g. through publications, coursework, or conference participation).
* Interest in human-robot communication (demonstrated e.g. through existing publications on the topic).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, and to communicate progress / issues clearly.
* Willingness to mentor the more junior group members.
* We are looking for an excellent researcher who is curious, critical, and can be a good team member.


***The following experience will strengthen your application:***


* Experience in qualitative data analysis (e.g. video-based thematic analysis, conversation analysis), conducting user studies, and/or meta-reviews.
* Experience working in interdisciplinary environments.
* Experience supervising students.
* Experience conducting research "in the wild" (e.g., field deployments or data collection in real-world environments).

**What you will do**
--------------------


* Develop your own research profile by collaborating on existing research projects as well as leading your own.
* Help and mentor PhD students in the project.
* Participate and contribute to regular group meetings.
* You will have the chance to supervise thesis work, and collaborate with other PhD students and postdocs.
* You will have the chance to take courses that will strengthen your academic profile, such as leadership, pedagogical skills, etc, offered by Chalmers
* Possibility to engage with teaching at undergraduate / master's level.


The position is meritorious for future roles in academia, industry, or the public sector.


**Contract terms**
------------------



The position is a temporary full-time employment for two years with the possibility of a one-year extension.



The position requires physical presence throughout the entire employment. A valid residence permit must be presented by the start date, otherwise the offer may be withdrawn.



Start date is **November 1st**, or as soon as possible thereafter.


**What we offer**
-----------------


* As a postdoc at Chalmers, you are an employee and enjoy all employee benefits. Read more about working at Chalmers and our benefits for employees.
* A dynamic and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg.
* Read more about Sweden’s generous parental leave, subsidized day care, free schools, healthcare etc at Move To Gothenburg.


Chalmers is dedicated to improving gender balance and actively works with equality projects, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence. We celebrate diversity and consider equality and inclusion as fundamental aspects of all our activities.



If Swedish is not your native language, Chalmers offers Swedish courses to help you settle in.


**Application procedure**
-------------------------


*The application should be written in English be attached as PDF-files, as below. Maximum size for each file is 40 MB. Please note that the system does not support Zip files.*


#### **CV**


* A comprehensive CV, including a complete list of publications.
* Details of any previous teaching and pedagogical experience.

#### **Personal letter**


* A brief introduction about yourself and what drew you to this position.
* An outline of your future goals and research focus.
* The letter should clearly state why you are interested in the topic, and why your profile fits the topic description. Generic personal letters will result in the application being discarded.


Use the button at the foot of the page to reach the application form.  

  

A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.  

  

**Please note:** The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete. Incomplete applications and applications sent by email will not be considered. Contact details to references will be requested after the interview.


**We welcome your application no later than 9th October 2026.**


#### **For questions, please contact:**
**Ilaria Torre**
**Assistant Professor**
**ilariat@chalmers.se**


### **We look forward to your application!**


*\*\*\* Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position.* \*\*\*


*Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.*  

*Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.*

description:

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

------------


The focus of this role is agentic systems that enable end-to-end optimization of AI workload performance on AMD hardware. You will join a team developing tools that support the broad adoption of agentic optimization loops to safely and reliably optimize AI workloads. This opportunity combines platform and tooling engineering with hands-on work in inference serving and agentic systems.

### **Tooling for Multi-Workload / Multi-Platform Agentic AI Performance Optimization**

* Develop and enhance tooling that improves the developer and operator experience across the performance optimization stack. Collaborate with researchers and engineers to transform optimization capabilities into reliable, well-tested, and well-documented solutions.

Sweden, Finland, Germany or UK. Remote work arrangements may be considered for candidates located outside office locations.

title: Quality Engineer - Battery Cell Design

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**We're looking for an Senior AI Engineer**
-------------------------------------------


Join us in transforming the digital signage landscape. PLAYipp, the leading Nordic digital signage company, is seeking a senior engineer to own features end-to-end — from PRD to Production — which increasingly include building AI capabilities directly into our product. At PLAYipp, we don't write code by hand — everything is built by directing AI coding tools (we use Claude Code), and you're fully accountable for what ships, however it was written. You'll be working in a Team, alongside Product and fellow Engineers — each of you carrying a bigger slice of the work than in a traditional setup, but never working alone.

**About PLAYipp**
-----------------


At PLAYipp, we deliver comprehensive, user-friendly digital signage solutions that empower businesses to communicate effectively and innovate. Our platform enables organizations of all sizes to manage and showcase content seamlessly across various screens, enhancing communication and customer engagement.


We're also at the forefront of how software gets built, constantly pushing for new ways to work more efficiently with AI without ever compromising on code quality. If you like being at that edge, this is the place.

**Key role description**
------------------------


You own features end-to-end: front end, back end, testing, and the architecture decisions along the way. You're never on your own with this — your team, our chief architect, and our Head of AI are there to support you whenever you need it.


Beyond product features, you'll also help build AI into how the whole organization works — tools that let AI handle work that used to require an engineer.

**What we expect from you**
---------------------------

**Building, Testing & Maintaining the Product**

* Take requirements from PRD to finished, deployed feature.
* Write and maintain tests as part of building — quality is your responsibility.
* Ownership — you ship it, you're responsible for it in production.
* Think about scalability and architecture, together with our Chief Architect, as a natural part of building, not an afterthought.

**Building AI Into the Product**

* Build AI-powered capabilities into the PLAYipp product itself.
* Work with LLM APIs and related tooling to get these features to production, not just prototypes.

**Internal AI Enablement**

* Occasionally build internal tooling that helps the wider organization become more self-sufficient with AI — e.g. giving non-engineers direct, self-serve access to data that used to require an engineer.
* Bring in new AI tools and workflows as they prove useful, and keep pushing for more efficient ways to work with AI without compromising quality.

**Team Collaboration & attitude**

* Share knowledge — on architecture, testing, deployment, and AI tooling — through documentation and workshops.
* Help team members grow their technical skills, including AI-assisted development.
* Lead by example in communication, drive and creativity.
* Foster a collaborative, learning-oriented team culture.

**Required Competencies**
-------------------------

##### **Technical Skills**

* 7+ years of professional experience in full-stack development, with demonstrated progression in technical complexity and responsibility.
* Practical experience building AI/LLM-powered features in a production product.
* Strong expertise in TypeScript, React, and Node.js — enough to review, judge, and be fully accountable for AI-generated code. Even though AI writes it, you own every line and are the one who fixes it when it breaks.
* Deep understanding of modern web application architecture, including RESTful APIs.
* Proficient with relational databases (MySQL or similar), including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.
* You shouldn't have been coding manually for some time; Claude Code experience specifically isn't required, but AI-directed development should already be how you work.
* Comfortable with ownership, not just writing code and passing it along.
* Nimble and adaptable — comfortable moving between product feature work and internal tooling/enablement work as priorities shift.

**Location & Schedule**
-----------------------

* Hybrid but primarily based, 3 days/week minimum, at PLAYipp HQ in central Gävle.
* Core collaboration hours for team synchronization.

**Why Join PLAYipp?**
---------------------

* Work with a talented and enthusiastic team in an innovative and growing company.
* Shape how AI gets built into a market-leading product, not just talk about it.
* Be part of a small, tight-knit team where you carry real ownership — without working alone.
* Enjoy a dynamic and collaborative work environment that values creativity and initiative.
* Opportunity to make a significant impact on the digital signage industry.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.


If you're ready to build the future of digital signage with AI at the core of how you work, apply today.

**Locations:** PLAYipp HQ Gävle **Remote status:** Hybrid

title: Collection officer

As we move into the future, we rely on state‑of‑the‑art methods to test and verify next‑generation electric machines, inverters and power electronics in a highly efficient and accurate way.



To meet upcoming challenges, we are expanding and enhancing our test facilities to secure the capability to test, verify, and validate electric machines, inverters, and power electronics. At the same time, we continuously develop our test methods to ensure we verify next‑generation cars effectively and correctly.

Your mission is to ensure that we build the right environments with the right capabilities to meet verification demands. You will also work on extending existing test capabilities and ensuring that new test environments are seamlessly integrated into our current software infrastructure.



Our test environment portfolio covers a broad spectrum of propulsion-related verification areas. Because of this, how you best contribute will depend on your competence and experience.

* Experience in technical leadership


* Strong communication and presentation skills

  



Personality & Potential are Key



You are an curios team player, who possesses strong communication skills, but are also comfortable working independently. You have an analytical- and solution-based mindset, that empowers your ability to draw technical conclusions out of complex systems. You improve structure and process as a natural part of your work. You are cooperative by nature and bring out the best in others. You possess strong communications skills, a genuine interest in technology and are driven by constantly learning and improving, both yourself and your scope.

 **Volvo Cars. For Life.**  

For nearly a century, Volvo Cars has empowered people to move freely in a personal, sustainable and safe way. Today, we are driving bold advancements in electrification, sustainability and automotive safety. title: Software Engineer, AI
description:
Hedvig is rewriting the rules of insurance, proving that it’s possible to disrupt an entire industry while keeping people’s best interests at heart. We’re on a mission to make insurance genuinely great and that starts with building products that deliver real value. AI is becoming a core part of how we build, and we’re now searching for someone who can help us take the next step.
 



  





**What about the role?** 




 We are looking for a driven backend-focused software engineer with hands-on experience building AI-powered functionality in production, who can help us shape and improve our AI-powered product experiences at Hedvig. You will work across our stack, collaborate closely with product and design, and contribute directly to bringing practical, reliable AI capabilities into our products.
 



  





 A concrete example of the work: we're automating parts of our claims journey, so that straightforward claims can be resolved in minutes, end to end. That means real customers, real money, and a high bar for getting it right. The interesting problems are in the edge cases, the evals, and knowing when to hand off to a human.
 



  





 You’ll spend most of your time building features, designing systems, and improving our product. You'll also take part in our AI initiatives, trying out approaches, sharing what you learn, and helping shape how we use, and utilize, AI responsibly and effectively.
 



  





 You’ll work with our modern tech stack, which includes:
 


* Kotlin with Spring Boot
* Next.js and Vercel
* Swift
* GraphQL
* Microservices
* Services on AWS and GCP
* A wide variety of LLM implementations, both from the major suppliers as well as local models



  





 You don’t need to be an expert in all of these, but you should be comfortable navigating complex systems and learning new technologies when needed.
 



  





**What about you?** 




 You have strong engineering fundamentals and a track record of delivering high-quality software. You are knowledgeable about, and intrigued by, the new capabilities that cutting-edge AI can enable, and you already use AI as part of how you build — shipping AI-assisted code into production systems, with judgment about where these tools accelerate real work and where they need close human review.
 



  





 We believe you’ll thrive here if you:
 


* Have a couple of years of hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating AI or LLM-powered functionality in production. You’ve worked beyond prototypes and experimentation and have dealt with the realities of making AI features reliable for actual users
* Have experience in areas such as LLM integrations, model APIs, agentic or automated workflows, evaluations, guardrails, observability, or human-in-the-loop systems. You don’t need experience in all of these, but we expect meaningful depth in some of them
* Come from a mostly backend-heavy background and are comfortable designing and owning production systems
* Bring strong computer science fundamentals and a pragmatic approach to system design
* Are comfortable working through ambiguity and finding the simplest thing that works without over-engineering
* Are motivated by solving real customer problems, with a focus on purposeful and impactful use of technology



  





**What about us?** 




 At Hedvig, we challenge assumptions, push boundaries, and believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We foster a culture of trust, ownership, and curiosity, where mistakes are part of learning, feedback is normal, and engineers can grow and make a real impact.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
**The role**
 We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to own the definition, scaling, and expansion of AI/ML solutions at Redpine. Our mission is to be the leading knowledge layer for trusted AI data. You will develop and implement machine learning solutions that power our platform, so organizations can source, validate, and manage high-quality training and inference data.
   

  

 You will be among the first key employees building algorithms for data quality assessment, automated validation and evaluation, and intelligent data matching. We interview on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application sooner rather than later.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and implement machine learning models for data quality assessment and validation.
* Develop algorithms for automated data labeling and annotation verification.
* Create and maintain data processing pipelines for various AI training data types.
* Develop and optimize matching algorithms between data providers and buyers.
* Implement scalable solutions for processing and analyzing large datasets.
* Collaborate with the product team to develop new features for the marketplace platform.
* Research and implement state-of-the-art ML techniques for data quality improvement.
* Work with customers and stakeholders to understand and implement data requirements for various AI use cases.


**What we're looking for**
* Strong experience in developing, training, and deploying AI / Machine Learning models.
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, R, Scala, Hugging Face).
* Knowledge of model deployment techniques and serving frameworks like TensorFlow Serving, TorchServe, or custom APIs.
* Experience with large-scale data processing and distributed computing.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes, as well as version control tools such as Git.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable writing queries, exploring data, and collaborating on hypotheses with product and engineering counterparts.
* Proficiency in independently setting up and managing cloud services that support scaling on a global level.
* A Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning or similar is a plus.


**Why this role**
 You will be one of the first people defining how Redpine uses ML on licensed data: quality, validation, matching, and evaluation. The work sits on the path between data owners and the models that consume that data.
   

  

**Practical details**
* Based at Redpine HQ in central Stockholm. Office-first, with real autonomy for deep-work days and life admin.
* Requires a valid Swedish work permit or similar eligibility. Relocation support available.
* Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
* Small team, high ownership. The same people design, ship, and run the systems.


**About Redpine**
 If models were the first wave of AI, and compute the second, we are building the data layer that comes next. Only a small fraction of the world's data is on the open internet. The rest, high-quality, domain-specific, often critical, sits behind paywalls, in databases, or with rights holders. Redpine is building the infrastructure to unlock it.
   

  

 We provide AI builders and autonomous agents with access to licensed, high-quality, multimodal data through a unified platform and API. The goal is simple: make AI systems more accurate, more useful, and grounded in real-world information.
   

  

 You will work closely with the founding team, including Anders (ex-partner at VC, McKinsey) and David (ex-tech and product leader at Spotify, Zettle, and Lunar). We are backed by Nordic Ninja, Node VC, and Luminar, alongside angels from OpenAI, Spotify, and Perplexity.
   

  

 If you are eager to make a meaningful impact in the AI space, we would love to hear from you. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: SVT söker Senior Fullstackutvecklare
description:
Tänk om vi kunde lägga mindre tid på administration och manuella arbetsprocesser och mer på innovation, lärande och värdeskapande arbete. På SVT bygger vi nu interna lösningar med AI och automation för att göra just det möjligt.
   

  

 Genom att ta bort tidsödande och repetitiva moment i vårt arbete vill vi frigöra tid hos både utvecklingsteam och övriga verksamheten. Tid som kan användas till att utforska nya idéer, lära snabbare och utveckla framtidens public service. SVT hanterar dagligen enorma mängder ljud, video, text och bild. Journalister behöver sålla bland hundratals tips, arkiven innehåller decennier av rörligt material och redaktioner behöver faktakolla snabbare än vad som är möjligt manuellt. Tekniken finns. Det som behövs är någon som kan få den att fungera i vår verklighet, med våra system och våra användare.
   

  

 SVT har ambitionen att vara det mest innovativa medieföretaget i världen. Automation och AI är inte ett sidospår i den resan, utan en av våra viktigaste möjliggörare för att nå dit. Som en Senior Fullstackutvecklare är du en av dem som gör det möjligt.
   

  

**Vad Vi Erbjuder Dig**
 Som Senior Fullstackutvecklare i SVT:s AI- och automationsteam bygger du end-to-end-lösningar som sträcker sig från backend-tjänster och integrationer hela vägen till användarvänliga gränssnitt. Du arbetar nära verksamheten och teamen och utvecklar lösningar stegvis utifrån återkoppling och faktiskt användning. Här delar vi idéer och lärdomar tidigt, snarare än att arbeta fram färdiga lösningar på egen hand. Du blir en del av ett litet, tvärfunktionellt team med högt mandat och nära koppling till SVT:s AI hubb. Rollen är medvetet bred: du är delvis backendutvecklare, delvis frontendutvecklare och delvis systemakitekt.
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som**
* Har djup praktisk erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling. Du är trygg på både backend-sidan och frontend-sidan och rör dig obehindrat mellan dem.
* Har goda programmeringskunskaper i Java/Kotlin, Rust, Python och/eller Node.js för backend-tjänster, integrationer och databehandling.
* Bygger frontend med moderna ramverk som React, Vue eller motsvarande, och har god känsla för UX och användarupplevelse.
* Har djup erfarenhet av API-design och systemintegration. REST, GraphQL, webhooks och event-driven arkitektur.
* Bygger och driftsätter AI‑lösningar i produktion och arbetar med konsekvenser som uppstår i verklig användning.
* Har praktisk erfarenhet av LLM‑API:er, RAG‑pipelines, prompt engineering och agentbaserade arbetsflöden.
* Förstår säkerhet i integrationer. OAuth2, API-nycklar, rate limiting.
* Har vana av CI/CD, testning och DevOps-kultur. Kvalitet är ett delat ansvar i teamet.
* Har erfarenhet av containerisering och Kubernetes i produktionsmiljö.
* Trivs i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och teknik och kan översätta behov till robusta lösningar.
* Är teknikagnostisk i ditt tänk och väljer verktyg och lösningar utifrån problem, inte tvärtom.
* Är van att arbeta med ofullständig information, högt tempo och mål som förändras. Du skapar struktur där det inte finns någon.
* Har relevant utbildning inom datavetenskap, systemteknik eller motsvarande — eller en portfölj som bevisar att du inte behöver den.


**Det Är Meriterande Om**
* Du har erfarenhet av RPA- och automationsverktyg som OpenRPA, UiPath, MS Power Automate eller liknande.
* Du har erfarenhet eller intresse av att arbeta med säkerhet, informationsklassning och ansvarsfull AI-användning.
* Du har erfarenhet från mediebransch eller annan innehållsintensiv verksamhet.


**Vad Tjänsten Innebär**
 Som Senior Fullstackutvecklare i automationsteamet på SVT kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Utforska användarbehov och ta fram lösningar tillsammans med andra utvecklare och UX/Workflow Specialists. Du förstår problemet innan du skriver en rad kod.
* Designa och bygga end-to-end-lösningar, från datakälla och backend-tjänster till användarnära gränssnitt.
* Bygga och förvalta APIer med tydliga kontrakt, versionshantering och dokumentation. Lösningarna ska vara återanvändbara, inte engångslösningar.
* Utveckla lösningar som gör automation begriplig och enkel att använda för medarbetare med varierande teknisk mognadsgrad.
* Bygga robusta flöden med felhantering, loggning och observerbarhet.
* Bygga och integrera AI-lösningar med SVT:s befintliga system, både legacy och moderna, och säkerställa att lösningarna faktiskt når användaren.
* Bidra till teamets gemensamma DevOps-kultur: testning, CI/CD-pipelines, kodgranskning och deployment.
* Dela lärdomar med andra och bidra till golden paths inom utvecklar-communityn på SVT.


**Olika perspektiv gör oss bättre**
 På SVT vill vi bygga team som speglar samhället vi verkar för. Vår tekniska miljö är idag mansdominerad och vi ser gärna att fler kvinnor söker våra utvecklingsroller. Alla kandidater bedöms utifrån kompetens och erfarenhet i en strukturerad rekryteringsprocess, på lika villkor.
   

  

**Hur Du Ansöker**
 I den här rekryteringsprocessen använder vi oss av urvalsfrågor och CV i stället för att be om personligt brev. Det gör vi för att säkerställa att rekryteringen blir kompetensbaserad och effektiv och att vi får samma viktiga information av alla kandidater. Välkommen med din ansökan senast 13 september. Intervjuer sker löpande.
   

  

**Annat Som Är Bra Att Veta**
 Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm med minst 51 % närvaro på plats. Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. För mer information om tjänsten kontakta gruppchef Sorosh Seddigh på sorosh.seddigh@svt.se och Peter Kurzwelly på peter.kurzwelly@svt.se. Facklig information lämnas av Fanny Lindhé (SACO), Maria Nassikas (Unionen) och Jane Andersson (SJF). Samtliga nås via växeln, tfn 08-784 00 00.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Product Image Engineer Stockholm
description:
**Job Title**
 Product Image Engineer Stockholm
   

  

**Job Description**
**Product Image Engineer to our R&D site in Stockholm**
*At Axis, we’ve always been about pushing the boundaries in pursuit of innovating for a smarter, safer world. We do this by developing IP-based products and innovations for security and video surveillance. We’re looking for a Product Image Engineer to help us develop more network tech innovations at our Stockholm site!*
**Who is your future team?**
 Working together in a team, you will be a part of how our new multi-channel cameras come to life. At Axis, product image engineers are responsible for the product image quality, thus they are involved in the whole product development process.
   

  

 In this role, you will collaborate with co-workers from different disciplines, such as mechanical design, electronics, software, production testing and many more.
   

  

 Our most important asset is our ability to cooperate, act as a team, and be open. If you are a person that likes to get involved, make a difference, and nudge the world a little bit in the right direction, you will feel at home with us.
   

  

**What You´ll Do As a Product Image Engineer**
 As an Image Engineer at Axis you will work in a cross functional team to develop new cameras from a concept phase to a complete product. Your responsibility will be to optimize the image regarding optics, image sensor and image processing. You will also setup production tests and support the production test flow by analyzing test results/statistics, on- and off-site. The role as a Product Image Engineer is very broad, and you will work closely with many different roles and organizations at Axis.
   

  

 Your main tasks will be:
   

  

* Optimizing image quality in new camera development projects. This is done by tuning auto-exposure and auto-focus, noise filtering, white balance, color-calibration and other image processing algorithms. Participating and contributing to the choice of optics and image sensors. This is done in cooperation with the mechanics and electronics teams as well as external partners.
* Supporting the production test flow in camera projects by testing prototypes on production machines on- and off-site and by analyzing test data/statistics.
* Developing prototype cameras and testing them in our imaging lab as well as outdoor, both in day and night conditions and following GDPR.


**Who are you?**
 You are curious, have a great passion for technology, love challenges and enjoy solving them in a team-focused atmosphere.
   

  

 You also have relevant education in engineering (master’s degree level), and have 2-3 years’ experience working with hardware, e.g. optics or electronics. You enjoy not only simulation and analysis work but also hands-on work with hardware in the lab. You are structured and organized, and like contributing to the team's way of working.
   

  

 It’s a plus if you have experience with
   

  

* Optics/electronics (such as cameras, microscopes, telescopes etc.)
* Image sensors
* IR filters and IR diodes
* Image processing algorithms
* Linux development environment


**What Axis has to offer:**
 This is a unique opportunity to be part of building our new R&D office in Stockholm. On one hand, having the advantages of being a small and agile site while at the same time being part of an exciting, successful organization that is already the world leader in network video.
   

  

 We want you to enjoy working with us, and we offer benefits such as flexible working hours, morning coffee every day, Friday cake, company bonus, attractive wellness benefits, health insurance and your very own Axis bicycle - to name a few.
   

  

**Curious to discover more?**
 We have a host of places where you can learn more about Axis; our products and solutions, our company culture, and what working at Axis is really like. Check out:
   

  

 Life at Axis blog
   

  

 Engineering at Axis blog
   

  

 Innovation at Axis

 Join us! We go through applications continuously so don't wait - apply today!

 We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.
